objects.description: [LockBit 3.0](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1202) can encrypt targeted data using the AES-256, ChaCha20, or RSA-2048 algorithms.(Citation: Joint Cybersecurity Advisory LockBit JUN 2023)(Citation: Sentinel Labs LockBit 3.0 JUL 2022)(Citation: Joint Cybersecurity Advisory LockBit 3.0 MAR 2023)(Citation: INCIBE-CERT LockBit MAR 2024)
objects.description_fa: [LockBit 3.0](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1202) می‌تواند داده‌های هدفمند را با استفاده از AES-256، ChaCha20 یا RSA-2048 رمزگذاری کند. الگوریتم‌ها.(Citation: Joint Cybersecurity Advisory LockBit JUN 2023)(Citation: Sentinel Labs LockBit 3.0 JUL 2022)(Citation: Joint Cybersecurity Advisory LockBit 3.0 MAR 2023)(Citation: INCIBE-CERT LockBit MAR 2024)
